HG26-fxw1: Note that many guidelines for treating major trauma recommend one or more of trauma-focused variants of cognitive behavioral therapy (sometimes called cognitive processing therapy, prolonged exposure, etc), or eye movement desensitization and reprocessing. Depending on the guideline and your situation, it may recommend one or the other or both. These can be supported by self-hypnosis and inner child work. If you're working with high-risk trauma, you need a bigger container.
